title: Eight Words, Read Rather Than Recognised
label: ch:ur-script-seven
canDo: I can read salam, kya, kan, nak, lal, kala, nila and lena letter by letter from the right rather than from the romanization, and explain why Urdu leaves its short vowels unwritten.

payoff.summary: Eight words the book had only ever given by ear, read letter by letter from the right -- including kan and nak, the same three letters in different orders, which is the proof that the reader is decoding rather than recognising. Every letter the reading needs was taught back in chapters one to five.
